message.content:
Here’s a classic set‑up you’ll find in most chocolate‑cake recipes—feel free to tweak it based on your taste and dietary preferences!

| Ingredient | Typical Amount (per ~9‑inch round) | Notes |
|------------|-------------------------------------|-------|
| **All‑purpose flour** | 1 ½ cups (190 g) | Gives structure; sifted for even mixing. |
| **Granulated white sugar** | ¾ cup (150 g) | Sweetness level; some bakers use brown sugar for extra moisture. |
| **Unsweetened cocoa powder** | ⅔ cup (60 g) | Darker, more intense chocolate flavor. |
| **Baking soda** | ¼ tsp (≈1 g) | Works best if you’re adding acidic liquid (e.g., milk + lemon). |
| **Salt** | Pinch (~0.5 tsp) | Enhances overall flavor. |
| **Eggs** | 2 large | Adds richness & helps bind everything together. |
| **Milk** | 1 cup (240 ml) | Whole milk gives a moist crumb; oat/almond milk works too. |
| **Vegetable oil** | ⅓ cup (80 mL) | Keeps batter silky; unsalted butter also fine. |
| **Vanilla extract** | 1 tsp (5 mL) | Classic aroma enhancer. |
| **Boiling water** | ½ cup (120 mL) | Activates cocoa, creates a lighter texture. |

> **Optional extras:**  
> • *Buttermilk* instead of regular milk for tangy depth.  
> • *Sour cream* or yogurt for added tenderness.  
> • A splash of espresso or strong brewed coffee to intensify chocolate notes.  

Mix dry ingredients first, then combine wet ones separately before blending them all together. Once baked at around 350°F (175°C), let cool before frosting!
